notes:
Currently working on my own text animator component in @framer Adds a few things the native one doesn’t have: – Relative units (% / vw / vh) – Scroll-based animations – Masking / clipping – Works with Fit Text Plus: – Animate per character, word, line, or element – Linked text layers so you can use native Framer text styles – Built with @motiondotdev (native Framer animation library)

Designer: @ludoviclosco. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
